# anecdotes_control_category (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up an existing control category by category ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anecdotes_control_category" "common_criteria" {
  category_id = "control_category_12345"
}

output "category_name" {
  value = data.anecdotes_control_category.common_criteria.category_name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `category_id` (String) The ID of the control category to look up.

### Read-Only

- `category_name` (String) The name of the control category.
- `framework_id` (String) The ID of the framework this category belongs to.
